combat_history.event: Paraded in Beijing in a refined low-observable configuration after a 2013 first flight.
combat_history.significance: Signalled China's pursuit of penetrating stealth unmanned strike.

modernization.description: Navalised variant tied to the catapult-equipped Type 076 assault ship.
modernization.impact: Could give China carrier-based unmanned stealth strike.

vulnerabilities.description: Sensors, autonomy, weapons and true signature are unverified.
vulnerabilities.context: Operational status and capability are uncertain.

vulnerabilities.description: Tailless designs are demanding to control and integrate.
vulnerabilities.context: Technical risk in a hard aircraft class.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Penetrating strike and ISR in contested airspace; potential carrier-based operations from Type 076.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Potential teaming with crewed fighters (e.g. two-seat J-20S) and carrier groups.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: The U.S. fielded a carrier UAV as a tanker first; the GJ-11 points to carrier-based stealth strike.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: How the US and China approach carrier drones.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Western flying-wing UCAV demonstrators that largely did not enter service; China appears to be fielding the concept.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: Why China is fielding the stealth UCAV the West shelved.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Wing Loong is a permissive-airspace workhorse; the GJ-11 is built for the peer fight.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: China's two faces of unmanned strike.

doctrine.role: Stealth unmanned combat aircraft for penetrating strike and ISR in contested airspace.
doctrine.employment: Low-observable flying-wing carrying internal munitions through modern air defences; potential carrier launch from Type 076.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Survivability and penetration — the peer-fight counterpart to the Wing Loong.
doctrine.threat_context: Signals China's intent to compete at the leading edge of unmanned combat aviation over the Pacific.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the MQ-25, Western flying-wing demonstrators and China's own Wing Loong.
